twins.rule: C := any eligible conflicting vote by an existing candidate author; Q := at least k distinct eligible candidate authors; action = reject_conflict if C else accept if Q else wait
twins.append_only_monotonicity: Only for policy-authenticated, on-time and well-formed messages with candidate/round/quorum/policy fixed: append valid candidate vote from new author can only increase Q, not create C; append conflicting vote by currently represented candidate voter makes C true and preserves Q. This is a deterministic rule prediction, not model score monotonicity.
twins.improper_claim: Votes may be represented by a boolean signature validity flag; this does not independently verify real cryptographic source authentication or an attacker-controlled message ingress.

lanl.rule: R := prior valid failure count >=5 or known distinct destinations >=3 in valid window; triage = investigate if R, else record_failed_attempt if current failure else continue_monitoring
lanl.append_only_monotonicity: Only under fixed current event, fixed time window, stable source destination identities and a valid prior failure added within the window, R is nondecreasing. There is no total-order authorisation ranking among all three triage labels; only the investigate indicator is a monotone predicate.
lanl.improper_claim: Triaging a security event does not enforce authorization and noninvestigate labels are not both allow.
